info.title: BenchCore API
info.description: Current unversioned HTTP API, not a frozen API v1 or a 1.0 release promise. All mutations require an exact trusted Origin, including credential/consent endpoints. Administrator operations additionally require an active admin cookie session. Errors use stable error identifiers, optional localized message and optional English issues. Regular JSON body cap is 256 KiB unless documented otherwise. Quotas are process-local, not fleet-wide. Cookie-dependent responses are private/no-store. Source handlers and Zod input validators are authoritative; JSON Schema cannot express every cross-field, byte-count or domain rule. See docs/API.md for deployment differences.

Error400.description: Invalid JSON, query, input fields or domain rules.

Error401.description: Missing, expired or revoked session, invalid credentials or rejected factor.

Error404.description: Missing or unavailable resource; unpublished resources remain masked.

Error405.description: Method not allowed; Allow lists supported methods.

Error409.description: Conflicting state, duplicate identity/slug or changed saved usage.

Error413.description: Request body exceeds the byte limit.

Error429.description: Process-local quota exceeded; back off. Quotas are not shared across replicas.

Error500.description: Generic internal failure; no stack trace or credentials are returned.

Error502.description: Storage operation failed; inspect operation-specific recovery instructions.

Error503.description: Required service, storage capability or configuration unavailable.

session.name: session
session.description: Opaque HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie obtained from login; Secure in production. No bearer-token API exists. Admin role is documented per operation, not an OAuth scope.

Login.description: Exactly one identifier; the legacy email field also accepts a username. A fresh six-digit code is required when TOTP is enabled.

PasswordChange.description: The new password must differ from the current password.

VaultImport.description: At most 500 files and 2,000,000 aggregate UTF-8 source bytes. Paths must be safe vault-relative paths: no backslashes, absolute paths, colon, empty, dot or parent segments.

CampaignInput.description: Subject must not contain CR or LF. Saving never sends email.
